purpose: Storefront colour/design grouping only. Preserve every product ID, variant ID, stock location, price, measurement record and order identity. Never delete or replace underlying products.
review_basis: Direct visual inspection of all 16 source boards carrying A panels and contact sheets of every current A-panel product; selected adjacent C construction panels also inspected. Source correspondence, cut, neckline, closure, pockets, sleeve and hem checked. No grouping inferred from generic names or historical counterpart_product_ids.
limitations: Not a manufacturing pattern equivalence certification; charts must remain tied to selected underlying product.

All currently imported A-panel products reviewed. Non-A designs were screened by identity; selected C families reviewed visually. No claim that all 682 products have received image-by-image cross-board duplicate certification.
Source-only A families not imported are covered by board review, but not proposed as existing stock options.
Historical counterpart_product_ids are unsafe for grouping: e.g. women tops linked to mens tees and baggy bottoms linked to backpacks.

Two colours sufficient for material; genuine/faux stay separate product options with honest materials.
Olive optional for mock-neck basics; tops, midi dresses and maxi dresses remain separate.
Olive instead of bone for workwear bomber; vest, cropped and long cuts stay separate.
Controlled evening palette; no wholesale bright colours.
Split running, layered compression, mesh basketball and tailored/pleated get individual construction-specific imagery.
